To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have studied the reliability and the electrical characteristics of ultra-thick (20 nm) and ultra-thin (2 nm) HfYO x dielectrics with and without a Si inter-layer on n-GaAS substrate.

the Si inter-layer in the HfYOx/Si/n-GaAs stack is found to be effective in reducing the gate leakage current, and also the trap density, which in turn improves the reliability of the dielectrics under high electric field stress.

the HfYOx gate dielectric with an Si interface control layer shows a good reliability with a high TDDB ( t bd  > 1700 s), which is much better than that of HfYOx directly deposited on GaAs ( t bd ˜100 s) under high electric field.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the electrical and reliability characteristics of HfYO x dielectrics on n-GaAS substrates and the results indicate that the HfYOx/Si gate stack has a good reliability performance.
the study of charge trapping and the reliability characteristics of ultra thin HfYO x dielectric films on n-GaN substrate.
understanding the charge trapping behaviour of ultra-thin gate dielectrics and their reliability characteristics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HfYO x with Si interface control layer is a promising gate dielectric material for GaAs-based MOS devices.
the introduction of Si interface control layer in HfYO x dielectric stack improves its charge trapping characteristics, reliability and dielectric breakdown properties.
the introduction of a Si inter-layer in between the HfYOx and GaAs interface improves the reliability of the Hf-based dielectric stack.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of a Si inter-layer improves the reliability and charge trapping characteristics of HfYO x film on n-GaAS.
the Si interface control layer has a significant role in improving the dielectric breakdown characteristics of the HfO x gate dielectric on n-GaAS.
the introduction of a Si inter-layer in the HfYOx /GaAs stack has a significant influence in the charge trapping and reliability characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of the Si inter-layer in the gate dielectric stack enhances the reliability and the breakdown voltage.
the presence of a Si inter-layer improves the charge trapping characteristics of the HfO x gate dielectric.
the presence of the silicon inter-layer improves the dielectric properties, and hence, the reliability of the Hf-based dielectrics on GaAs.
